body:
RandoWand

This is a simple Minecraft mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that adds a working randomization wand to the game.

What it does It adds a wand that randomizes blocks when you add them to it, which helps with building gradients in Minecraft. It is a simple mod with simple mechanics, so don't expect anything special.
if you have mod ideas or how to improve this mod contact me on discord, Toxic_bullet
